paragraphs: The M8 Competition uses the S63 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8. It was fitted from 2019 across the F91 (Convertible), F92 (Coupe) and F93 (Gran Coupe) generations. The S63 is the same engine family used across BMW's most potent M models, including the M5, X5M and X6M, sharing the hot-vee turbo layout that places both turbochargers within the engine's V.
about.boldParagraph: The M8 Competition is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 fitted to the M8 Competition from 2019 to 2026 across all three body styles (F91 Convertible, F92 Coupe, F93 Gran Coupe). Known for valve seal and coolant system wear from the hot-vee turbo layout pattern — see the callout above. We replace valve seals and coolant components as standard on every S63 rebuild.
